facts.topic: The economy counts every rupee that changes hands, but not the hours that never do.
facts.decode: Markets price every transaction but never the hours of unpaid care that sustain them.

slides.headline: The economy counts every rupee that changes hands, *but not the hours that never do.*
slides.takeaway: Markets price every transaction but never the hours of unpaid care that sustain them.

slides.title: Open on the data, not a definition
slides.flat: The economy is important for growth and money matters to everyone. Work should be valued.
slides.why: Restates topic, no tension, no thesis.
slides.working: Before a rupee moves, hours already have. Three hundred and five minutes, uncounted daily. A ledger that ignores time cannot balance.
